newsitem.title: USA: Quintiles to acquire Innovex Ltd of UK.
newsitem.headline: Quintiles to acquire Innovex Ltd of UK.

text.p: Quintiles Transnational Corp said Monday it had a reached a definitive agreement to acquire Innovex Ltd, a private British pharmaceutical firm, in exchange for 10 million Quintiles shares.
The merger is expected to be accretive to earnings by $0.05 to $0.07 per share for 1997, Quintiles spokeswoman Pat Grebe said.
Quintiles said it expects a one-time charge in the deal but has not determined the amount.
Quintiles currently has about 20 million outstanding shares, Grebe said.
The deal would be a pooling of interests and close later this year, pending approval by Quintiles shareholders, the company said.
Quintiles said it would retire about $60 million of existing Innovex obligations upon closing.
Quintiles said Innovex is believed to be the largest privately-held contract pharmaceutical organization in the world, supplementing sales and marketing of drugs for 25 pharmaceutical companies.
Innovex recorded $129.1 million of net revenue for the fiscal year ended March 31, 1996, up from $80.4 million in the previous year, Quintiles said.
